items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I had Hank Jones, Tommy Potter, and myself.

ctx.x: ... We got up to about the 50's. We got up to 54th Street with us working. I worked with you and Joe Bushkin and Buck Clayton and Stuff Smith at the Embers and then we all went our separate ways. You stayed there with your own trio...
I had Hank Jones, Tommy Potter, and myself.
Didn't you start with Don Abney when Joe Bushkin left?
